title: Playful bouncy
prompt: Playful bouncy intro for a kids' app called "Boop!". Colorful candy shapes (circles, stars, rounded squares) drop in and bounce with squash & stretch, jostle each other, then the letters B-o-o-p-! hop in one by one like they're on a trampoline. Everything should feel elastic and joyful. End with a little idle wiggle.

checklist.text: per-letter hop (text animator by char or separate letter layers)
idle wiggle at the end (motion in the last 0.8s)
